judgments.rationale: The source sets out disjunctive disqualifications connected by 'or' between paragraphs (4) and (5), meaning a person is disqualified if any single condition applies. The proposed summary changes the logic to 'unless all of the following are true' joined by 'and', which incorrectly requires an individual to satisfy all five disqualifying conditions simultaneously before being disqualified.

Empty action and object fields are valid when the default statement already expresses that meaning. Filling action and action_quote alone without resolving any defect or adding missing qualification links is not a needed correction.
